entities.text: International Union of Bakers and Confectioners

nary_nodes.label: UIBC names Castel World Confectioner of the Year
evidence: the International Union of Bakers and Confectioners (UIBC) named him World Confectioner of the Year last month
Castel received the UIBC award presented annually to a leading figure in the profession in recognition of their career and contribution to the trade on July 14 in Singapore

nary_nodes.label: Nina Métayer crowned champion
evidence: Three years after fellow French pastry chef Nina Métayer was crowned champion

Three years after fellow French pastry chef Nina Métayer was crowned champion, Castel received the UIBC award presented annually to a leading figure in the profession in recognition of their career and contribution to the trade on July 14 in Singapore.

nary_nodes.label: Castel sets out on his own
evidence: When Castel set out on his own in 2012
When Castel set out on his own in 2012 after working with chef Hélène Darroze, at the prestigious Hotel Costes and La Grande Epicerie de Paris, he discovered the art of breadmaking.

nary_nodes.label: Watching pastry chef spin sugar Château de Chambord
evidence: watching a pastry chef spin a model of the famed Loire valley Château de Chambord out of sugar while out to dinner three years later
But it was watching a pastry chef spin a model of the famed Loire valley Château de Chambord out of sugar while out to dinner three years later that set him firmly on the path of pastry-making.

nary_nodes.label: Opening new venue in Paris
evidence: he is set to open a new venue in Paris in September
Alongside his daughter Margot, he is set to open a new venue in Paris in September – a cross between a café, a restaurant and a bakery-patisserie.

nary_nodes.label: Castel is 54 years old
evidence: His fingers covered in cookie dough, the 54-year-old with salt-and-pepper hair had returned to his usual routine as an "artisan-retailer" after the International Union of Bakers and Confectioners (UIBC) named him World Confectioner of the Year last month.

nary_nodes.label: Montbabut worked with Castel for six years
evidence: who has been working with him for six years
The pastry chef is "demanding, he has this slightly perfectionist side we're very fond of", said Montbabut, who has been working with him for six years.

nary_nodes.label: Castel wanted to be chef from age seven
evidence: From the age of seven, he wanted to become a chef
From the age of seven, he wanted to become a chef and received his first recipe book.

nary_nodes.label: Castel's mission to be world champion every day
evidence: I have a mission: to be the world champion every day in my shop for my customers
"I have a mission: to be the world champion every day in my shop for my customers," he said, eyes twinkling.

nary_nodes.label: It's all about the product
evidence: Castel has never strayed from his motto: "It's all about the product."
At the helm of several establishments in Paris, Castel has never strayed from his motto: "It's all about the product."

nary_nodes.label: Our work is no trivial matter
evidence: Our work is no trivial matter, every day we make things that people put into their bodies
"Our work is no trivial matter, every day we make things that people put into their bodies," said Castel, who hails from Brittany in western France.

nary_nodes.label: Product dictates the recipe
evidence: The funny thing with this profession is that it's the product that dictates the recipe

"The funny thing with this profession is that it's the product that dictates the recipe," he said enthusiastically from his kitchen, which opens onto the shop and the dining room, a popular spot for brunch.

nary_nodes.label: Montbabut praises Castel's perfectionism
evidence: The pastry chef is "demanding, he has this slightly perfectionist side we're very fond of"
The pastry chef is "demanding, he has this slightly perfectionist side we're very fond of", said Montbabut, who has been working with him for six years.

nary_nodes.label: Montbabut says Castel loves to pass things on
evidence: He's there alongside his workers every day and loves to pass things on
"He's there alongside his workers every day and loves to pass things on," he added.

nary_nodes.label: Castel identifies as pastry chef above all
evidence: But above all else, I'm a pastry chef.
"But above all else, I'm a pastry chef."

nary_nodes.label: Artists push to try new things
evidence: Because they're not technically limited in their ideas, it pushes us to try new things
"Because they're not technically limited in their ideas, it pushes us to try new things," he said.
